# Preface {.unnumbered}

This website presents my perspective on writing in science, technology,
engineering, and mathematics (STEM),
with a focus on writing about statistical data analysis.
Most of its rules also apply to informative prose in general.
I intend to give it to academic mentees as a style guide reference,
and also use it as a notebook for myself.

The [Introduction](chapters/intro.qmd) describes the book's scope and readers,
and how to use its chapters.
The [Summary](chapters/summary.qmd) lists the book's main rules
as a checklist for revising a draft.

## Acknowledgments

The site is built from the [qwt](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/qwt) Quarto website template,
whose structure comes from the [UCD-SERG lab manual](https://ucd-serg.github.io/lab-manual/),

[Benjamin-Chung Lab Manual](https://jadebc.github.io/lab-manual/index.html).
